reviewer: Independent original-pixel, actual-reference and source reviewer

entries.alt: Four disciples near the water look toward two white-robed angels while light surrounds the group.
entries.caption: Still in their wet clothing, the disciples look up to receive the angels' ministry. The light around them recalls the heavenly fire witnessed by the multitude after their baptism.
entries.findings: V3 compared to rejected original and v2. Four foreground recipients are adult male chosen disciples; mixed observers remain distant and outside the encircling glow. No head flames, burning hair or Christ figure. Far-right angel now has short graying hair, beard and visibly mature distinct face, resolving near-duplicate angel pattern. The main angel engages kneeling recipient in reciprocal gaze; wet woven cloth, hands and faces photographic. Circle of light is an explicit artistic rendering of as-if-fire language.
conditions: Only part of the twelve is pictured; do not claim four total disciples or identify an unnamed figure as mapped Nephi. Angels' appearance and geometric light boundary are interpretation; the source does not specify a literal luminous ring. Christ's return follows in verse15.
Accept v3 only and preserve rejected predecessors. Technical review is not owner approval or browser verification.
